title: engine.config.json — the product's constants, in one place
description: Every value the engine, the server, the doctor and the release tooling would otherwise hand-write twice. Consumers read it; ARC-01 only defines it.

$schema.description: Editor hint only. Declared so additionalProperties:false does not reject it.

product.description: Names the global config directory (~/.config/<product>/). Separate from `cli` on purpose: renaming one must not silently rename the other (D-01(b)).

cli.description: Names the command the user types.

serverKey.description: The key in .mcp.json. Letters, digits, - and _ only (D-01); it becomes part of every generated permission rule, mcp__<serverKey>__<tool>.

permissions.description: How the generated permission blocks in .claude/settings.json are written. allowStyle "explicit" lists one entry per read tool — deterministic and lint-checkable; "glob" is implemented and tested but not selected, because a glob buys nothing worth a matching bug. askStyle "ask" prompts on every mutating tool; "deny-with-hook" is the S-18 fallback.

floors.description: Minimum supported versions. The doctor reads these (01 section 8, section 12).

git.description: 2.34.1 per ADR-0008 (Accepted 2026-09-07), which supersedes ADR-0001's 2.25.0: below 2.34.1 nothing is measured, and the corpus recipe needs 2.34.1 plus the root-file repair step.

family.description: Upstream release-family branches (00 section 3.10). main/mobile/nofamily/other/store are not release families. ARC-03's `snowarch docs family <name>` must extend this enum when ServiceNow adds one.

pin.description: Full SHA. Must equal the vendor/ServiceNowDocs gitlink once ARC-03 creates it — enforced by tests/engine-config.test.mjs, which reports the check as skipped until then.

upstream.description: The submodule URL. Must equal .gitmodules submodule.vendor/ServiceNowDocs.url — asserted by tests/docs-pin.test.mjs, because a config naming a different upstream than the one git will clone is worse than no config. Constrained by PATTERN, not `format: "uri"`: plain Ajv ships no format validators, and in strict mode an unknown format is a hard error ("unknown format \"uri\" ignored"), so the story's `format: uri` would have made every run of tests/engine-config.test.mjs throw. The pattern is also tighter than `uri` — it accepts only an https git URL, which is the only shape a submodule clone here may take.

roster.description: Expected counts, cross-checked against the files on disk by the test — 00 section 3.8 records that these drift when they live in prose.

utility.description: Skill directories that are tooling rather than a specialist persona — the /snowarch skill. They are excluded from the roster count, listed in their own table by gen-roster.mjs, and exempt from the persona rules (EXAMPLES.md, the ## Triggers section). One source for all of them.

licence.description: ARC-11-C1. Where the signed revocation list is fetched from: by git, from this explicit address, never from origin, so a fork cannot substitute its own list.

repo.description: owner/name on GitHub, fetched over HTTPS, or a full URL

ref.description: the branch that carries the list

path.description: the list's file on that branch
